The only GSP refusal that differs between off and on is 0x20800a5d. The host release path was called 0 times. Every display boot's guest dmesg is non-empty with 25 NVRM lines.
failures: Display B5 (GOP unload lane) FAILS at 8a682f1b: DISPLAY_B5_VERDICT FAIL arms=14, failed=3 in the stage run and failed=2 in 2 repeats. The failing arms are B5A2_CONSOLE and B5A2_PRESERVED, plus B5A2_AFTER_SESSION once. After X11 Cinnamon (NVIDIA X driver, modeset=0) exits, kf3 logs 'scanout REFUSED context DMA 0x10088 on channel 7: NotBound' before the PRESERVE_HW window and core frees. It then shows 'BLACK … no head is lit' instead of 'the PRESERVED scanout', and the text console stays black.

This is NOT a candidate regression: master's code (kf3-bins/d4c3767b, the code of 789dee9f, built by this box's own mb_gop merge bar) fails B5 identically on vmb in 2 of 2 alternating runs, with the same refusal line. The display code on that path is unchanged between master and the candidate. Likely mechanism, inferred from the code and logs rather than run directly: every scanout copy re-resolves each window's context DMA (crates/kf-qemu/src/display.rs:2106), and when nobody is watching the console a copy is due every 250 ms (display.rs:1997). The guest unbinds the console context DMA before freeing the windows. On vast 54032077 that gap was 153 ms, so the earlier pass was timing-dependent; here it is 346 ms to 2.2 s, so a copy falls inside it and the window is refused.
